name: Enertia Equatorial
original_name: エナーシャ・エカトリアル
source:
A weak girl possessed by the fairy Aqua. She is in a romantic relationship with Touri.

[spoiler]She died while giving birth to Lupinus. This was completely willing on her part, as she only had a few years left to live anyways and didn't want Touri to be alone. She never told him that she knew she would die, instead telling Aqua that it was a "secret."[/spoiler]
